description: tools/test-projects/input (WEB_PROJECT=input tools/build.sh web): Input.getPointerLockState() with a captured pointer is PENDING until a user gesture, then LOCKED after the gate's synthetic click (CDP Input.dispatchMouseEvent). No pixel check: the scene is empty. Then a CDP touch tap switches the input scheme to Touch and a key press back to Keyboard&Mouse (input-device-awareness AC18). The scheme's second switch focuses the form's e-mail field (text-entry-gamepad-cursor-back-button AC22): the IME textarea then has inputmode email and enterkeyhint send (eval), and Escape reaches the menu document's back listener.
eval: (function(){ var t = document.getElementById('jasper-ime'); return t ? 'ime ' + t.getAttribute('inputmode') + '|' + t.getAttribute('enterkeyhint') : 'no ime textarea'; })()
